title: The Static of Halcyon Drift
author: Rosalind Underhill
blurb: Juniper Pemberton, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
